question: धुळे मंडीत मका साठवावा की विकावा?
answer:
मका विकण्यापेक्षा साठवण्याचा निर्णय घेण्यासाठी खालील महत्त्वाचे गोष्टींचा विचार करा:

1. **बाजारभावाचा विश्लेषण** - धुळे बाजारात मका विकताना विक्री दर व विक्री सुविधा तपासा. जर बाजारभाव चांगला असेल आणि विक्री लवकर झाल्यास विकणे चांगले ठरू शकते.

2. **मका साठवण्याची व्यवस्था** - मका साठवण्यासाठी शुष्क, थंड, आणि वातावरण नियंत्रित ठिकाण निवडा. आर्द्रता व तापमानाचे नियंत्रण ठेवणे महत्त्वाचे आहे. आर्द्रता 12% खाली ठेवणे आवश्यक आहे. जर आर्द्रता जास्त असेल, तर प्रोपिओनिक ऍसिड वापरून बंद करणे चांगले ठरू शकते.

3. **मका विक्रीच्या वेळेवर निर्णय** - जर बाजारात मका उत्पादन जास्त असेल, तर विक्री दर कमी होऊ शकतात. त्यामुळे तुम्ही विक्रीच्या वेळेवर निर्णय घेण्याची आवश्यकता आहे.

4. **सुरक्षित साठवण** - साठवण्यासाठी विशेष ट्रक्टर, बंद गोदाम, किंवा नियंत्रित तापमान वापरणे चांगले ठरू शकते. जर आपल्याला सुरक्षित साठवण उपलब्ध नसेल, तर विक्रीचा निर्णय घ्या.

**स्रोत: शेती व्यवस्थापन**

आपल्याला धुळे बाजारात मका विक्रीच्या दराची माहिती हवी आहे का? किंवा आपण वेगळ्या ठिकाणासाठी मका साठवण्याची व्यवस्था कशी करावी, याबद्दल माहिती हवी आहे का?

The commodities futures market has been prevalent since the end of the nineteenth century. The first futures market for cotton [कापूस] was established in Mumbai in 1885. Futures markets for cereals were created in Mumbai in 1900, in Kolkata for jute [ताग] in 1912, and in Hapur for wheat [गहू] in 1913.

The concept of the futures market started in December 2003, and an investment [गुंतवणूक] of three lakh [लाख] crore rupees has been made in it. This concept is a very important matter for farmers and for the agricultural business as a whole, because today farmers are never told or presented with the prices of agricultural goods in other marketplaces. Even today, traders have complete freedom to determine the prices of agricultural goods, and often the farmer [शेतकरी] only knows the rate at which agricultural goods were sold after the bill comes into their hands. This is a very unfortunate matter.

Due to the futures market, farmers can earn more profit [नफा] by making proper use of various crops/cropping systems and production [उत्पादन] technologies according to their agricultural meteorological department. Also, after receiving the agricultural production [उत्पादन], the farmer [शेतकरी] can store it in a warehouse [गोदाम], avail facilities like loans and insurance on the production [उत्पादन], and sell the agricultural goods at the right price at the right time. Since most Indian farmers are small and marginal, they can decide their cropping system [पीक प्रणाली] by taking up-to-date information on future prices, and it can help them in making investment [गुंतवणूक]-related decisions accordingly. The futures market also plays a valuable role in keeping the flow of imports and exports in the global market at the right level. This can increase the export [निर्यात] of agricultural goods in the global market. Considering all these factors from the point of view of agricultural development [कृषी विकास], the concept of the futures market is very useful as a long-term solution.

In the futures market, one knows what the current price is and what the future price will be at the same time. However, this future price is not an estimate, but we can actually buy and sell at that price. Currently, in the spot market, goods come first and then the deal, while in the futures market, the deal comes first and then the goods.

The futures market is the buying and selling of goods in the future. The futures market is the most efficient market for revising future prices, as brokers participating in this market trade based on up-to-date price-sensitive information. A futures market or an advance market is one in which the purchase and sale transaction of goods is decided in the present, i.e., on the current date, but the actual delivery of the goods is to be done in the future on a fixed date, so it is called a futures market. Generally, there is no actual exchange of goods in the futures market or advance market, but only the exchange of the amount of profit [नफा] or loss in this transaction is done between the buyer and the seller.

To control the irregular and harmful trading of agricultural commodity [व्यापार करण्यासाठी वापरली जाणारी मूलभूत वस्तू किंवा उत्पादन] prices, the Central Government enacted the Forward Contracts (Regulation) Act in 1952. The main purpose of this act is to control the transactions of giving and taking in the futures market, to ban the gambling-like agreements of goods, and to take other decisions related to the futures market. These tasks are carried out in cooperation with the Forward Markets Commission. Based on the clauses in this act, the government keeps an eye on the trends appearing in the prices of goods from time to time and imposes restrictions on the futures market of various goods.

- The Government's price policy for major agricultural commodities seeks to ensure remunerative prices to the growers for their produce with a view to encouraging higher investment [गुंतवणूक] and production [उत्पादन] and to safeguard the interest of consumers by making available supplies at reasonable prices. question: आत्ता मका विकावा की काही दिवस थांबावे?
answer:
मका आपल्या जवळच्या बाजारात २५०० ते ३८०० रुपये प्रति क्विंटल मध्ये विकला जात आहे. आता विकण्याचा किंवा थांबण्याचा निर्णय घेताना आपल्याला लक्षात घ्यावे लागते की:

- आपल्या जवळच्या बाजारातील मका दर किमान आधारभूत किंमत (MSP) पेक्षा कमी आहेत. मका वरील किमान आधारभूत किंमत २,५०० रुपये प्रति क्विंटल आहे.
- आपल्याला अजून एक किंवा दोन दिवस थांबून दर वाढतो का ते जाणून घ्यावे लागते. जर आपल्याला अधिक दर मिळाल्यास वाटत असेल, तर थोडे दिवस थांबण्याचा विचार करा.
- जर आपल्याला नेहमीच बाजारात विकण्याची आवश्यकता नसेल, तर आपल्या शेतात किंवा जवळच्या गोदामात सुरक्षितपणे ठेवून दर वाढताना पाहू शकता.
- जर आपल्याला वेळेवर विकण्याची आवश्यकता असेल, तर आपण आता विकू शकता.

आपल्याला आपल्या जवळच्या बाजारातील मका दर तपासायचे आहेत का, किंवा इतर बाजारांचे दर पाहायचे आहेत का?

**स्रोत: बाजारभाव**

question: सध्या माझ्या परिसरात ज्वारीचे भाव वाढतायत का?
answer:
ज्वारीचे बाजारभाव जवळच्या बाजारांमध्ये वाढत आहेत. मालेगाव, वाशिम येथील बाजारांमध्ये ज्वारीचे भाव सध्या ₹4,450 प्रति क्विंटल इतके आहेत. या भावांच्या वाढीमुळे शेतकऱ्यांना उत्तम नफा मिळू शकतो. तथापि, या भावांमध्ये वाढ लक्षात घेता, शेतकऱ्यांनी ज्वारीचे विक्रीचे निर्णय घेताना जवळच्या बाजारांमध्ये भावांचा अधिक तपास करणे आवश्यक आहे. आपण इतर बाजारांमधील भावांची माहितीही जाणून घ्याल का?

**स्रोत: बाजारभाव**

question: आज माझ्या भागात भात विकायला फायदा होईल का?
answer:
आपल्या भागात आज तांदूळ विकताना फायदा होईल का, हे आपल्या वापरलेल्या बाजारातील भावांवर अवलंबून असते. आपल्या भागातील नुकत्याच मिळालेल्या बाजारभावानुसार:

- माध्यमिक तांदूळ (बासमती तांदूळ) चे बाजारभाव १७०० रुपये प्रति क्विंटल असू शकतो.
- आपल्या शेतातील उत्पादनाचे बाजारभाव आणि वेळ यांच्या आधारे विक्री करणे फायदेशीर ठरू शकते. तांदूळ विकताना आपण नुकत्याच उतरलेल्या बाजारभावाच्या तुलनेत वाटप किंवा शेतात थोडी वाढ देता येते, जेणेकरून नंतर विक्री करताना अधिक भाव मिळू शकतो.

बाजरीचे बाजारभाव जवळच्या शिरपूर बाजारात खालीलप्रमाणे आहेत:

question: माझ्या परिसरात मका साठवून ठेवावा का विकावा?
answer:
मका साठवण्याची आणि विक्रीची शिफारस अशी आहे:

**साठवण (Storage):**
- मका ताज्या आणि कोरड्या ठिकाणी साठवा. आर्द्रता 12% पेक्षा कमी असावी.
- प्रोपायोनिक ऍसिड मिसळून जास्त आर्द्रता असल्यास साठवण्यासाठी वापरा.
- कीड नियंत्रणासाठी डेल्टामेथ्रिन 2.5% किंवा डायटॉमेकस ऍर्थ व मॅग्नेशियम सल्फेट 500 ग्रॅम प्रति 100 किलो वापरा.
- बंद बॉक्स किंवा बॅगमध्ये ठेवा आणि तापमान 15-20°C ठेवा.

**विक्री (Selling):**
- मका ताज्या आणि उत्तम दराने बाजारात विकून नफा मिळवा.
- विक्रीसाठी जवळच्या बाजारपेठेत जाण्याची शिफारस करतो.
- मका चारा किंवा उत्पादनासाठी वापरताना उत्तम गुणवत्तेचा निवडा.

आपल्या परिसरातील बाजारभाव आणि साठवण्याच्या नियमांसाठी जवळच्या बाजारातील भाव तपासायचे आहेत का?

question: सध्या माझ्या भागात कापूस विकायला योग्य वेळ आहे का?
answer:
कापूस योग्य वेळी काढण्यासाठी, खालील गोष्टी लक्षात घ्या:

- कापूस काढण्याची पहिली वेळ त्याच्या शेतामध्ये ३० ते ३५ टक्क्यांच्या बोल्या फुटल्यावर करा. त्यानंतर दोन ते तीन वेळा, प्रत्येक १५ ते २० दिवसांच्या अंतरावर काढणी करा.
- सकाळी काढणी करणे चांगले आहे, कारण वातावरणातील आर्द्रतेमुळे कापूस वर जास्त तळा किंवा शेंडे चिकटू शकतात.
- प्रथम चांगला, नवीन कापूस काढून घ्या, नंतर पावसाने भिजलेला, रंग बदललेला किंवा अपूर्ण कापूस वेगळा ठेवा.
- वेगवेगळ्या किंवा जातीचे कापूस वेगळ्या ठिकाणी ठेवा. काढून घेतल्यावर ते दोन ते चार दिवस उन्हात वाळवून ठेवा, नंतर शुष्क आणि शुद्ध ठिकाणी साठवा.

यामुळे कापूस चांगला राखवता येतो आणि बाजारात उत्तम दर मिळतो. काढणीच्या वेळी तुमच्या शेतातील कापूसाची स्थिती आणि वेळ योग्य आहे का, ते तपासून घ्या.

question: जवळच्या मंडीत ज्वारी विकल्यास किती भाव मिळेल?

question: सध्या माझ्या भागात बाजरीचे दर कसे आहेत?

question: माझ्या जवळच्या बाजारात भात विकायला चांगला भाव आहे का?
answer:
**स्रोत: बाजारभाव**  
महाराष्ट्रातील भात (पिकाचे दाणे) बाजारभाव विशेषतः नंदुरबार व पुण्यात उपलब्ध नाहीत. पुण्यातील बाजारभावानुसार, भाताचे दाणे आणि भाताची शेती बाजारात खूप वेगळी असते. भाताचे दाणे विक्रीसाठी बाजारात उपलब्ध आहेत, पण त्यांचे विशेष दर उपलब्ध नाहीत.

आपण जवळच्या बाजारात भात विकायचे आहे का, किंवा आपल्या शेतातील भात बाजारात विक्रीसाठी ठेवायचा आहे का? मला आपल्याला आणखी माहिती देता येईल का?

(Marketing Research and Information Network)

 1. INTRODUCTION :

1.1 Market information is needed by farmers in planning production [उत्पादन] and marketing of their produce and equally needed by other market participants in arriving at optimal marketing decisions. The availability and dissemination of complete and accurate marketing information is key to achieve both operational and pricing efficiency in the marketing system. Advancement in Information and Communication Technology (Information and Communication Technology) has made the world a smaller place and a larger market at one go. To fully utilize the new emerging marketing opportunities for the benefit of farming [शेती करणे] community, establishment of an Information and Communication Technology based "Agricultural Marketing [कृषी विपणन] Information Network" in the country has become inevitable.

1.2 Ministry of Agriculture [शेती] had launched the Information and Communication Technology based Central Sector Scheme [योजना] of Agricultural Marketing [कृषी विपणन] Information Network (AGMARKNET), in March, 2000, to link important agricultural produce markets spread all over the country and the State Agriculture [शेती] Marketing Boards and Directorates. The project is being executed with the technical support of National Informatics Centre (National Informatics Centre). A total number of 3,549 computers were provided under the scheme [योजना] to 3,241 agricultural produce markets (Annexure-I) up to March, 2013. Computers were also provided to State Agricultural Marketing [कृषी विपणन] Boards/ Directorates, etc. An application software package 'AGMARK [ॲगमार्क]', has been developed to facilitate organization and transmission of market data from the markets.

1.3 In order to strengthen interface with farmers and other beneficiaries, AGMARKNET portal (http://agmarknet.nic.in) has been developed. More than 2200 markets are regularly reporting price and arrivals related data which is being disseminated through the portal. The AGMARKNET portal also serves as a single window for accessing websites of various other organizations concerned with agricultural marketing [कृषी विपणन]. It provides weekly arrivals and price trend [किंमत कल] analysis for important markets in respect of major agricultural commodities transacted. It is also linked with Online Commodity Exchange [वस्तू विनिमय केंद्र] of India Limited, providing futures prices in respect of oilseeds, crops, etc. International price trends of various agricultural commodities available on Food and Agriculture [शेती] Organisation website are also accessible through the portal. The portal is constantly being enriched.

(Marketing Research and Information Network)

 1. INTRODUCTION :

1.1 Market information is needed by farmers in planning production [उत्पादन] and marketing of their produce and equally needed by other market participants in arriving at optimal marketing decisions. The availability and dissemination of complete and accurate marketing information is key to achieve both operational and pricing efficiency in the marketing system. Advancement in Information and Communication Technology (Information and Communication Technology) has made the world a smaller place and a larger market at one go. To fully utilize the new emerging marketing opportunities for the benefit of farming [शेती करणे] community, establishment of an Information and Communication Technology based "Agricultural Marketing [कृषी विपणन] Information Network" in the country has become inevitable.

1.2 Ministry of Agriculture [शेती] had launched the Information and Communication Technology based Central Sector Scheme [योजना] of Agricultural Marketing [कृषी विपणन] Information Network (AGMARKNET), in March, 2000, to link important agricultural produce markets spread all over the country and the State Agriculture [शेती] Marketing Boards and Directorates. The project is being executed with the technical support of National Informatics Centre (National Informatics Centre). A total number of 3,549 computers were provided under the scheme [योजना] to 3,241 agricultural produce markets (Annexure-I) up to March, 2013. Computers were also provided to State Agricultural Marketing [कृषी विपणन] Boards/ Directorates, etc. An application software package 'AGMARK [ॲगमार्क]', has been developed to facilitate organization and transmission of market data from the markets.

1.3 In order to strengthen interface with farmers and other beneficiaries, AGMARKNET portal (http://agmarknet.nic.in) has been developed. More than 2200 markets are regularly reporting price and arrivals related data which is being disseminated through the portal. The AGMARKNET portal also serves as a single window for accessing websites of various other organizations concerned with agricultural marketing [कृषी विपणन]. It provides weekly arrivals and price trend [किंमत कल] analysis for important markets in respect of major agricultural commodities transacted. It is also linked with Online Commodity Exchange [वस्तू विनिमय केंद्र] of India Limited, providing futures prices in respect of oilseeds, crops, etc. International price trends of various agricultural commodities available on Food and Agriculture [शेती] Organisation website are also accessible through the portal. महाराष्ट्रातील शिरपूर व त्याच्या जवळच्या बाजारांमध्ये कांद्याचे दर नुकतेच मिळालेल्या बाजारभावात पाहता, कांद्याची विक्री करताना चांगला भाव मिळू शकतो. अहवालानुसार, लासलगाव, बेंगळूर, पुणे, मुंबई, दिल्ली, चेन्नई या बाजारांमध्ये कांद्याचे दर एकमेकांवर परिणाम करतात. मुंबईतील कांद्याचे दर बेंगळूर, पुणे, दिल्ली आणि चेन्नई या बाजारांमध्ये देखील वाढतात. त्यामुळे आपण विक्री करण्याचा निर्णय घेताना या बाजारांच्या दरांचा अभ्यास करावा.

4. Not conceiving

Cows or buffaloes come into heat regularly but do not conceive or abort, meaning abortion [गर्भपात] occurs. There are also many reasons for this disease [रोग]. If there is an infection [संसर्ग] or uterine infection [संसर्ग], conception does not occur or abortion [गर्भपात] happens; in such cases, treatment [उपचार] should be sought from a veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक].

When treating this disease [रोग], one should use plants that are known to them and easily available in their homes.

- 5. Shatavari [शतावरी]

5.Retained Placenta [झार बाहेर न पडणे]

After an animal gives birth, the placenta [झार] from the uterus is expelled. Naturally, it takes eight to ten hours for the placenta [झार] to be expelled. But sometimes it does not come out and rots in the uterus. In such cases, infection [संसर्ग] occurs, and the animal gets a fever [ताप], with foul-smelling discharge [स्त्राव] coming from the uterus. If immediate measures are not taken, it affects the animal's reproductive capacity.

Often, some livestock [पशुधन] owners try to pull out a partially expelled placenta [झार], or there is a superstition in some places of tying a slipper or shoe to such a partially expelled placenta [झार]. This does not benefit but becomes a cause of infection [संसर्ग], so do not believe in such superstitions or perform any drastic measures for the livestock [पशुधन] owners. Treatment [उपचार] should be done on the advice of a veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक]. Otherwise, it has an adverse effect on the animal's health [आरोग्य].

The use of medicinal plants [औषधी वनस्पती] is very effective for this disease [रोग].

- 1. Ishwari
- 2. Kalonji
- 3. Cotton [कापूस]
- 4. Kalalavi
- 5. Harmal

question: माझ्या भागात सध्या नवीन कापूस पेरणीसाठी पुरेसा पाऊस झाला आहे का?
answer:
कापूस पेरणीसाठी पुरेसा पाऊस झाल्याची माहिती घेण्यासाठी, आपल्या भागातील पावसाची अंदाज आणि पेरणी वेळ ठरवण्यासाठी महत्वाचे आहे. विदर्भ भागात विविध जिल्ह्यांना अनुसार पावसाचे प्रमाण आणि वेळ थोडी बदलू शकतात, परंतु सामान्यतः पावसाळा ११ ते १७ जून दरम्यान सुरू होतो. या काळात पेरणीसाठी ७५ ते १०० मिमी पाऊस असल्यास कापूस पेरणीसाठी उत्तम ठरतो.

पावसाळा दोन ते तीन आठवड्यांनी देखील उशिरा झाल्यास (२ ते १५ जुलै), आपण वेळेवर पेरणी केल्यास उत्पादनावर जास्त परिणाम होऊ शकतो. या प्रकरणात, जर पावसाळा अधिक उशिरा झाला असेल, तर उशिरा पेरणीसाठी जलद पिकांची जात निवडणे आवश्यक आहे. उशिरा पेरणीसाठी (१० ते १५ जुलै) उत्पादनात २४ टक्क्यांची कमी होऊ शकते, त्यामुळे योग्य वेळी पेरणी करणे महत्वाचे आहे.

स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ

आपल्या भागातील विशिष्ट पावसाची माहिती घेण्यासाठी किंवा आपल्या जवळच्या कृषी विज्ञान केंद्राशी संपर्क साधावा का?

**Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth**

From the agro-climatological point of view, the Vidarbha division [विभाग] is mainly divided into three climatic sub-divisions. Guaranteed rainfall area, medium rainfall area and high rainfall area. Even so, the rainfall from the general low-pressure patterns occurs roughly simultaneously throughout Vidarbha, and the duration of a low-pressure band is roughly the same throughout Vidarbha with little variation. There may be or may not be a change in the amount of rainfall. When the low-pressure zone is not fully over Vidarbha, the amount of rainfall in Vidarbha varies greatly from district [जिल्हा] to district [जिल्हा] as well as taluka-wise. Roughly speaking, the period of rainfall as well as non-rainfall is the same throughout Vidarbha. When the regular rainy season starts, rain reaches the whole of Vidarbha in about three days. Generally, the regular monsoon [पावसाळा] rains come to Vidarbha between 11th and 17th June (24th meteorological week). But there is no guarantee that the rainy season will start on time. If the rainy season starts late by one to two weeks, there is no need to change the crop planning [पीक नियोजन]. But if the regular monsoon [पावसाळा] starts more than two weeks late, it is called a contingency situation and in such a situation, changes have to be made in crop planning [पीक नियोजन], crop varieties [पिकांच्या जाती], fertilizer management [खत व्यवस्थापन] and number of plants per hectare. answer:
नाशिक भागात गेल्या दोन दिवसांत, ज्यांची तारीख ११ आणि १२ जानेवारी २०२६ आहेत, द्राक्ष बागेवर परिणाम होईल इतकी थंडी नव्हती. दोन्ही दिवसांच्या तापमानाचा विचार करता, मिनिमम तापमान ११.१ °C ते १२.८ °C दरम्यान होते, जे द्राक्षाच्या बागेवर फार थंडीचा परिणाम नाही. तापमानाचे मध्यम (१८.४९ °C ते १९.०५ °C) आणि आर्द्रता ७८.९६% ते ८१.२४% असल्याने द्राक्षाच्या बागेवर थंडीचा फारसा परिणाम होत नाही. आपण द्राक्षाच्या बागेवर थंडीचा परिणाम कसा टाळावा किंवा द्राक्षाच्या बागेची व्यवस्थापन कशाप्रकारे करावे आपल्याला अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

question: काल दुपारी सुटलेल्या वाऱ्यामुळे संत्रा बागेत फळगळ झाली असेल का?
answer:
संत्रा बागेत फळगळ होण्याचे अनेक कारणे असू शकतात, ज्यामध्ये दुपारीचा वाऱ्याचा प्रभावही एक असू शकतो. खालील व्यवस्थापन मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वे फळगळ कमी करण्यास मदत करतील:

1. **फवारणी वेळापत्रक:**
   - फळगळ रोखण्यासाठी, फवारणी करा:
     - एथेफॉन 600 पीपीएम (600 मिलीग्रॅम प्रति लिटर पाण्यात) फवारणी करा.
     - अथवा, हाताने फळांचे विरळणी करा.

2. **आंतरपीक:**
   - पहिल्या ३-४ वर्षांसाठी आंतरपीक घ्या, परंतु ज्वारी किंवा कापूस या पिकांचा वापर टाळा.
   - तण काढणे किंवा योग्य तणनाशकांचा वापर करून बासिन्स शुद्ध ठेवा.

3. **संत्रा फळधारणा व्यवस्थापन:**
   - अम्बिया बहार (जानेवारी-फेब्रुवारी) फुले उत्पन्न झाल्यावर, आठवड्याने एनएए १० पीपीएम (१० मिलीग्रॅम प्रति लिटर पाण्यात) आणि १% यूरिया (१० ग्रॅम प्रति लिटर पाण्यात) फवारणी करा.
   - मृग बहार (जून-जुलै) फुले उत्पन्न झाल्यावर, फवारणी करा: १५ पीपीएम जीबरेलिक ऍसिड (GA-3) आणि १५ पीपीएम सीपीपीयू (Forchlorfenuron) किंवा ब्रॅसिनोलाईड २ पीपीएम.

4. **साठवणी:**
   - फळ कापण्यापूर्वी, कार्बेंडाझिम ०.१% (१० ग्रॅम + १० लिटर पाणी) फवारणी करा. यामुळे फळांची साठवण वाढते.

5. **उन्हाळ्यात बासिन्स शांत ठेवा:**
   - उन्हाळ्यात, बासिन्सवर ५ सें.मी. रोपांची जाडी द्या. हे फळगळ आणि तापमान नियंत्रणास मदत करते.

संत्रा बागेत फळगळ कमी करण्यासाठी या व्यवस्थापन तत्त्वांचे पालन करा. अधिक माहिती किंवा विशिष्ट तंत्रज्ञानाबद्दल आपल्याला मदत हवी आहे का?

question: काल रात्री पडलेल्या धुक्यामुळे हरभरा पिकाचे नुकसान झाले असेल का?
answer:
हरभरा पिकासाठी धूक्यामुळे नुकसान झाले आहे का याची शक्यता असते. धूक्याने फुले, शेंगा आणि दाणे नुकसान पोहोचू शकतात. नुकसानाची अंदाजे माहिती असल्यास, ती तपासण्यासाठी आपण जवळच्या कृषी विज्ञान केंद्रात जाऊ शकता. धूक्याने झालेल्या नुकसानावर रोग नियंत्रणाच्या उपायांचा वापर करावा. धूक्यामुळे नुकसान झाल्यास, फुले आणि शेंगा तसेच दाणे तुटू शकतात. त्यामुळे रोग नियंत्रणासाठी कीड नियंत्रण रासायनिक साधने वापरावी. जर नुकसान झाल्याचे दिसत असेल, तर त्वरित विशेषज्ञांचा सल्ला घ्या.

question: कापसावर औषध फवारणी करण्यासाठी काल दुपारचा वाऱ्याचा वेग खूप जास्त होता का?
answer:
कापसावर औषध फवारणी करताना, वाऱ्याचा वेग खूप जास्त नसल्याचे आपल्याला वाटते. यासाठी आपल्या जवळच्या दिडगाव, सिल्लोड तालुक्यातील वाऱ्याचा वेग आणि इतर परिस्थिती तपासण्यासाठी मी जुन्या दिवसांची हवामान माहिती तपासली. १२ जानेवारी २०२६ रोजी, दिडगाव येथे वाऱ्याचा महाविद्यालयाच्या डेटानुसार मध्यम वेग (०.८७ किमी/तास) होता. याचा अर्थ आपण औषध फवारणी करताना वाऱ्याचा वेग खूप जास्त नव्हता. फवारणीसाठी वाऱ्याचा वेग लागू नसल्यास औषधाचा चांगला प्रभाव मिळू शकतो, तसेच ड्रोन फवारणीसाठी वाऱ्याचा वेग ५ किमी/तासापेक्षा जास्त नसल्यास फवारणीचे नुकसान होत नाही.

फवारणी करताना खालील महत्त्वाच्या गोष्टींची दक्षता घ्या:
- फवारणी केवळ वाऱ्याच्या निर्माणावर टाळून करा.
- ड्रोन फवारणीसाठी वाऱ्याचा वेग ५ किमी/तासापेक्षा जास्त नसावा.
- फवारणीच्या वेळी जमिनीत पाणी आणि आर्द्रता योग्य असावी.
- फवारणीसाठी निर्धारित ड्रॉपर वापरा आणि नुकसान टाळा.
- फवारणी करताना तापमान आणि आर्द्रता योग्य असावी.

आपल्याला फवारणीसाठी योग्य औषध किंवा ड्रोन फवारणीच्या तंत्राची माहिती हवी आहे का?

**स्रोत: कृषी दर्शन, डॉ. बी.एस. के. केवी, दापोली (२०२५)**
**स्रोत: ड्रोन फवारणीच्या दिशेने कृषी उत्पादनांची निर्देश सोप**

question: कालच्या कडक उन्हामुळे मिरचीच्या पिकात फुलगळ होण्याइतपत उष्णता होती का?
answer:
मिरचीच्या पिकात फुलगळ होण्याचा प्रामुख्याने उष्णतेचा परिणाम असतो. उच्च तापमानामुळे फुलांचा झुबका (inflorescence) सुकून गळतो, ज्यामुळे फळधारण कमी होते. अशा परिस्थितीत फुलांच्या झुबक्यांवर नियंत्रणासाठी योग्य उपाय घ्यावेत:

- फुलांचा झुबका आणि त्याच्या नजीकच्या पानांवर थांबवावे.
- फुलांच्या झुबक्यावर किंवा फुलांवर कोणतीही बुरशी दिसत असल्यास, त्याचे नियंत्रण करावे.
- उष्णतेच्या दरम्यान आवश्यक आर्द्रता राखण्यासाठी पाणी योग्य वेळी द्यावे.
- फुलगळाच्या नियंत्रणासाठी नैसर्गिक पद्धतींचा वापर करता येतो, जसे की शेणाचे टाचणे, तुडतुड्यांवर जास्त आर्द्रता राखणे, किंवा बायो-प्रोडक्ट्स वापरणे.

स्रोत: "Inflorescence pests of cashew" (ICAR Annual Report 2023-24)

question: काल रात्रीच्या दमट हवेमुळे माझ्या शेतात कीड लागण्यासाठी पोषक वातावरण तयार झाले आहे का?
answer:
कोरड्या व दमट्या हवामानामुळे शेतातील वातावरण कीड वाढीसाठी अनुकूल असते. दमट्या हवामानात मापकीड, फुलकिडे, व तुडतुडे या कीडींची वाढ वाढते व त्यामुळे पिकांचे नुकसान होते. अशा वेळी खालील काही उपाय करावेत:

- मापकीड व फुलकिडे नियंत्रणासाठी, कीटकनाशक फवारणी करा. दमट हवामानात जैविक कीटकनाशक (जैव खते) वापरणे उत्तम आहे.
- तुडतुड्यांच्या नियंत्रणासाठी, कीटकनाशकाची फवारणी करा. फवारणी वेळी पावसाळा वातावरणात वापरावे लागते.
- जैविक कीटकनाशक (जैव खते) वापरताना आर्द्रता (60-70%) आवश्यक आहे, त्यामुळे पावसाळ्यात वापरावे.
- फेरोमोन सापळे वापरून कीड नियंत्रणाचा नियमित व्यवस्थापन करा.
- शेतात तण काढणे, जमिनीची नांगरणी व वेळेवर फवारणी करणे उपयुक्त आहे.

स्रोत: कृषी दर्शनी, डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ

question: Why is my application for the scheme showing as 'Waiting List'?
answer:
**Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY) - Scheme Details**

**Introduction:**
Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY) is a special component scheme implemented by the Government of Maharashtra for Scheduled Caste and Neo-Buddhist farmers. It aims to improve their standard of living by providing irrigation facilities and other agricultural support.

**Benefits:**
The scheme offers subsidies for various components, including:
- New Irrigation Well: Maximum subsidy of ₹4,00,000
- Old Well Repair: Maximum subsidy of ₹1,00,000
- Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds: Up to 90% of the cost or ₹2,00,000
- Inwell Boring: ₹40,000
- Electricity Connection: ₹20,000 or actual cost
- Pump Set (Diesel/Electric): Up to ₹40,000
- Solar Pump: Up to ₹50,000
- HDPE/PVC Pipe: Up to ₹50,000
- Sprinkler/Drip Irrigation Sets: Up to ₹47,000 and ₹97,000 respectively
- Farm Machinery: Up to ₹50,000
- Backyard/Kitchen Garden: Up to ₹50,000

**Eligibility:**
- Only for Scheduled Caste/Neo-Buddhist farmers with a valid caste certificate
- Landholding limit: 0.20 ha to 6.00 ha (minimum 0.40 ha for new well)
- Must have an active Aadhaar-linked bank account
- Priority to Below Poverty Line (BPL) farmers and women/disabled beneficiaries

**Required Documents:**
- Caste Certificate
- 7/12 Land Report (within 3 months)
- GSDA Certificates

**Application Process:**
- Apply online on the Maha-DBT portal: [mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login)
- Applications are selected on a first-come, first-served basis
- Site inspections by Agricultural Officers for new well and old well repair proposals
- Prior approval must be obtained within 30 days of document submission

**Source: Government Scheme Information**

*Id*:
65

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

question: मी कोणत्या योजनेसाठी पात्र आहे?
answer:
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपण निम्न योजनांसाठी पात्र आहात:
1. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PMKISAN)** - नामो शेतकरी महासंमान निधी (NSMNY) योजनेखाली तुम्हाला वर्षाला ₹6,000 चे फायदा मिळतो.
2. **प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY)** - शेतीच्या नैसर्गिक आणि जीवाणू/रोगामुळे नुकसान झाल्यास विमा देण्याची योजना.
3. **डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)** - शेतकरी वर्गातील सर्वसाधारण आणि नवबौद्ध शेतकऱ्यांसाठी जलसंपदा, जलसंपत्ती, शेती मशीनरी यांसाठी अनुदान देणारी योजना.

प्रत्येक योजनेच्या पात्रता, फायदे, अर्ज प्रक्रिया आणि आवश्यक कागदपत्रांबद्दल विस्तारित माहिती हवी आहे का?

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

*Id*:

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-pmfby

*Sponsor*:
Central

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Main Component*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZB_bKSL1ifewQkA4-ksxeQfqWFfcoc_l/view

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

agristack_workflow.evidence: Eligibility query with Agristack ✅, but no fetch of Agristack/profile data is shown and the assistant directly asserted “आपण निम्न योजनांसाठी पात्र आहात”. No PoCRA/caste/land-size personalization performed.

term_identification.evidence: User asked general eligibility. Assistant picked some common schemes (PMKISAN, PMFBY, BAKSY), but ignored other obviously relevant ones (e.g., RWBCIS also fetched in tools) and gave a muddled mapping between PMKISAN and NSMNY.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Followed get_scheme_codes → multiple get_scheme_info calls. Did not use batch fetch, but order was acceptable.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - Document search not used for scheme info

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or JSON leaked. Only farmer-facing citation lines included.

source_alignment.evidence: BAKSY was described as for “सर्वसाधारण आणि नवबौद्ध” farmers, but tool shows it is ONLY for SC/Neo-Buddhist. NSMNY was conflated under PMKISAN bullet; tool states NSMNY gives ₹6000 per year in addition to PM-KISAN for PM-KISAN beneficiaries. Also PMKISAN and RWBCIS had 'No scheme data found', yet eligibility was claimed.

no_fabrication.evidence: Assistant declared the user is eligible for multiple schemes without tool-backed personalization or Agristack checks. While schemes themselves exist, eligibility assertions were ungrounded.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used correct farmer-facing source line: “स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती” (though duplicated).

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No inputs/chemicals or safety-sensitive advice involved.

completeness.evidence: Gave only 3 schemes and missed other key relevant ones (e.g., RWBCIS for crop insurance, irrigation/mechanization options, PoCRA-dependent schemes). No eligibility conditions, documents, or processes provided.

actionability.evidence: No portal URL, documents list, or step-by-step application flow. Only asked if more info is needed.

context_fit.evidence: No use of Agristack despite ✅; asserted eligibility broadly and misclassified BAKSY eligibility. No PoCRA check or caste/landholding consideration.

clarity.evidence: Bulleted list is readable, but PMKISAN–NSMNY conflation causes confusion about which benefit applies to which scheme.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a generic offer for more details, but no targeted follow-up to gather needed eligibility info (caste, land size, PoCRA).

grammar.evidence: Grammatically correct, simple sentences.

terminology.evidence: Basic terms like योजना, अनुदान, विमा used correctly; minor naming/typo issues (e.g., NSMNY phrasing) and scheme-role confusion.

language_purity.evidence: Minimal English; scheme names appropriately in English where standard.

fluency.evidence: Understandable but somewhat terse and generic; slight confusion reduces natural flow.

evaluation.summary: The response lists a few schemes but wrongly asserts eligibility and misstates BAKSY and NSMNY details, without using Agristack for personalization. It lacks completeness and actionability (no documents, URLs, or processes), reducing usefulness.

question: पशुपालनासाठी कोणत्या शासकीय योजना आहेत?
answer:
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

पशुपालनासाठी महाराष्ट्रातील महत्त्वाच्या शासकीय योजना खालीलप्रमाणे आहेत:

1. **बिरसा मुंडा कृषी क्रांती योजना (TSP आणि OTSP)**  
   - या योजनेमध्ये शेतकऱ्यांना नवीन खऱ्या, जुन्या खऱ्या दुरुस्ती, प्लास्टिक फार्म पॉन्ड लाईनिंग, बोरवेल, विद्युत संपर्क, पंप सेट, सोलर पंप, एचडीपीई/पीव्हीसी पाईप, स्प्रिंकलर आणि ड्रिप इरिगेशन, शेत यंत्रसामग्री, बॅकगार्डन आणि बोरवेल ड्रिलिंगसाठी अनुदान मिळते.
   - **पात्रता:** शेतकरी शेतमालक, जात प्रमाणपत्र, ७/१२ रसीद, बॅंक खाते आणि आधार कार्ड लिंक केलेले असणे आवश्यक आहे.
   - **लाभ:** नवीन खऱ्या अंदाजे ₹४ लाख, जुन्या खऱ्या दुरुस्ती ₹१ लाख, प्लास्टिक फार्म पॉन्ड ₹२ लाख, एचडीपीई/पीव्हीसी पाईप ₹५०,०००, स्प्रिंकलर इरिगेशन ₹४७,०००, ड्रिप इरिगेशन ₹९७,०००, शेत यंत्रसामग्री ₹५०,०००, बॅकगार्डन ₹५,०००, बोरवेल ड्रिलिंग ₹५०,०००.
   - **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** [महाडीबीटी पोर्टल](mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login/login) वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा लागतो.

2. **नामो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)**  
   - ही योजना शेतकऱ्यांना वार्षिक ₹६,००० दरम्यान लाभ देते.
   - **पात्रता:** शेतकरी, आधार कार्ड, बॅंक खाते आणि जात प्रमाणपत्र.
   - **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** [महाडीबीटी पोर्टल](mahadbt.maharashtra.govनी) वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा लागतो.

3. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**  
   - शेतकऱ्यांना वार्षिक ₹६,००० दरम्यान लाभ मिळतो.
   - **पात्रता:** शेतकरी, आधार कार्ड, बॅंक खाते.
   - **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** [महाडीबीटी पोर्टल](mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login/login) वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा लागतो.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
आपल्याला यापैकी कोणत्या योजनेची अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का? किंवा इतर कोणती शासकीय योजना शोधायची आहे?

*Id*:
64

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-bmkky

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Birsa Munda Krushi Kranti Yojna (TSP and OTSP)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Tribes (ST) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden
12. Drilling well/ Borewell

*Introduction*:
Tribal Sub-Plan (In-Area and Outside-Area) is being implemented since 1992-93 to increase the income of Scheduled Tribe farmers and improve their standard of living. Considering the needs of the farmers in the changed situation, as per the Government administrative approval Ref/letter No. Auyo 2416/Pr.No.177/4A, dated 9/8/2017. to revise the said scheme from the year 2017-18 vide Government Decision Also, the Government has decided to implement the said scheme under the name Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana (Inside-Area and Outside-Area).
Also, the Government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the Government decision dated 01 October, 2024.

*Benefits*:
The said scheme should be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 & components admmissible for subsidy are as follows.
 1. In the said scheme, the grant will be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
 1.1 For New Irrigation Well Maximum subsidy Limit is Rs. 4,00,000/- is admissible as subsidy
 1.2 For Old Well Repair Maximum subsidy Limit is Rs. 1,00,000/- is admissible as subsidy 1.3 For Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds Maximum subsidy Limit is Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy
 1.4 For Inwell Boring Maximum subsidy Limit is 40,000/- is admossible as subsidy
 1.5 For Electricity Connection Maximum subsidy Limit is Amount Rs. 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admossible as subsidy 1.6 For Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)Maximum subsidy Limit is For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy 1.7For Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)Maximum subsidy Limit is subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy 1.8 For HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item) Maximum subsidy Limit is Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy . 1.9.1 Under Micro irrigation system for Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant
 Maximum subsidy Limit is Under the Per Drop Plus Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 10% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana and (2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 15% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less is admissible as subsidy.
 1.9.2 Under Micro irrigation system for Drip Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant
 Maximum subsidy Limit is Under the Per Drop Plus Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 10% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana and (2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 15% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. 10.For Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)
 Maximum subsidy Limit is Ammount Rs.50,000/- is admossible as subsidy 11.For Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) Maximum subsidy Limit is 5,000/- is admossible as subsidy 12. For Drilling well/ Borewell (new item) Maximum subsidy Limit is Grant of Rs. 50,000/- or actual cost, whichever is less is admossible as subsidy.

*Eligibility*:
Beneficiary eligibility criteria:-
1.The beneficiary must be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Tribe category.
2.The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.The farmer must have a 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in his name.
 (Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika areas (Ref. Govt.t Letter No. Sankirna-2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dt. 24.4. 2018))
4.The beneficiaries must have their own bank account and the said bank  account must be linked to the Aadhaar card.
5.The beneficiary below the poverty line will be given first priority.6.The condition of Rs. 1,50,000/- annual income limit applicable to the beneficiaries of the said scheme is being abolished. The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the land of the tribal beneficiaries is in remote and fragmented areas, two or more beneficiaries with land holdings less than 0.40 hectares come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be allowed to benefit from the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of holding area will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
6.The priority order of beneficiary selection will be as follows.
6.1 Beneficiaries below the poverty line,
6.2 Tribal beneficiarie,
6. 3. Individual Forest leaseholders
6..4 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be admissible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years
6.3 If the benefit has been given from the tribal scheme for similar agricultural development schemes as well as from the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit given under this scheme will not be admissible.
6.4 A note will be made in the 7/12th statement of the beneficiaries who have taken the benefit of the said scheme.
District Selection Committee: -   The following committee will be constituted to finalize the selection of beneficiaries at the district level under Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana (Inside-sub plan Area and Outside sub plan Area) Scheme.
        Additional Chief Executive Officer, Z.P.                                                    - Chairman
        District Superintendent Agriculture Officer                                            - Member
        Executive Engineer, Minor Irrigation, Z.P.                                               - Member
        District Level Officer of Ground Water Survey System                         - Member
        Assistant Commissioner, Social Welfare                                                 - Member
        Special District Social Welfare Officer (Zilla Parishad)                          - Member
        Agricultural Development Officer, Z.P.                                                    -Member Secretary
For this scheme, applications from farmers will be invited on the Maha-DBT portal at mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ farmer/ login/ login and the applications received within the limit of the target received by the concerned talukas will be selected online on a first come, first served basis. For this, the target received district-wise will be entered on the portal at the Agriculture Commissionerate level. The funds made available to the districts under this scheme in the financial year 2025-26 should be distributed taluka-wise in a fair manner. For this, the financial target of each taluka should be determined in proportion to the total number of farmers in the Scheduled Tribe category in the district. The concerned districts should take action to enter the financial target of the said talukas on the portal. Eligible beneficiaries will be selected online from the interested farmers in the concerned taluka within the limit of this target. The approval of the District Selection Committee should be obtained for this. The selection list of beneficiaries in each taluka will be published on the MahaDBT portal on a first come, first served basis. Prior approval should be given to the beneficiaries within the financial target available for the district/taluka. The entire responsibility in this regard will rest with the concerned Agricultural Development Officer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate  of ST category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report  having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of 3 months
3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the      concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.                                                                                                                                        2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

*Id*:
61

*Scheme Code*:
sdda-farm-machinery-and-equipments

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
DDA MECHANIZATION

*Scheme Name*:
State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Farm Machinery and Equipments.

*Sub Component*:
Tractors, power tillers, automated machinery, tractor-operated implements, tractor-operated crop protection implements, and post-harvest primary processing implements.

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. Financial assistance to farmers for procurement of farm machinery and implements
2. Generally, the subsidy is given at a rate of 40 % for SC, ST & small farmers, Womens & 50% for other farmers percent of the cost or the maximum subsidy limit declared by the Central Government, whichever is lower.

*Eligibility*:
Individual Farmer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

question: माझ्या पिकासाठी कोणती शासकीय योजना आहे?
answer:
**Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi (NSMNY)**  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
या योजनेत, पीएमकिसान योजनेतील पात्र शेतकऱ्यांना प्रत्येक कुटुंबाला वर्षाला ₹6,000 फायदा मिळतो, जो तीन बरोबर भागांमध्ये दिला जातो. ही योजना पीएमकिसान योजनेच्या फायद्याव्यतिरिक्त दिली जाते. या योजनेसाठी अर्ज करण्याची आवश्यकता नाही, फक्त पीएमकिसान योजनेचा पात्र शेतकरी असल्याची नोंद असलेल्यांना हा फायदा मिळतो.

**Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)**  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
या योजनेचा लाभ शेतकऱ्यांना जमीन व जलसंपदा सुधारण्यासाठी मिळतो. यात नवीन जलस्रोत, पुरातन जलस्रोत दुरुस्ती, फार्म पॉन्डचे प्लास्टिक लाइनिंग, इनवेल बोरिंग, वीज जोडणी, पंप सेट, सोलर पंप, एचडीपीई/पीव्हीसी पाईप, स्प्रिंकलर आणि ड्रिप इरिगेशन, शेतमाल यंत्रसामग्री, आणि बॅकगार्डन यासारख्या विविध घटकांसाठी अनुदान मिळते. या योजनेसाठी शेतकऱ्याने शेतकरी वर्गाचा प्रमाणपत्र, जमीन निवड, आधार कार्ड, आणि इतर आवश्यक कागदपत्रे अपलोड करावी लागतात. अर्ज महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन करावा लागतो.

**Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PMKISAN)**  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
या योजनेत, पात्र शेतकऱ्यांना प्रत्येक कुटुंबाला वर्षाला ₹6,000 फायदा मिळतो, जो तीन बरोबर भागांमध्ये दिला जातो. या योजनेसाठी शेतकऱ्याने आधार, जमीन निवड, आणि इतर आवश्यक कागदपत्रे अपलोड करावी लागतात. या योजनेसाठी शेतकऱ्याने निवड अर्ज करावा लागतो.

आपण कोणत्या योजनेची अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का? किंवा आपल्या शेतासाठी इतर कोणत्या योजनांची शिफारस करायची आहे का?
