*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

term_identification.evidence: N/A - reason: योजना-सामान्य चौकशी; विशिष्ट कृषी संज्ञा/टर्म आयडेंटिफिकेशन लागू नाही.

tool_sequencing.evidence: get_scheme_codes नंतर get_scheme_info वेगवेगळ्या स्कीमसाठी कॉल केले (ठीक), पण get_multiple_schemes_info वापरले नाही. PMKISAN साठी get_scheme_info ला 'No scheme data found' आले तरी उत्तरात तपशील दिले.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - reason: डॉक्युमेंट सर्च वापरलेले नाही.

output_hygiene.evidence: टूल नावे/JSON लीक नाही; 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' योग्य पद्धतीने वापरले.

source_alignment.evidence: NSMNY व BAKSY तपशील साधारण टूल आउटपुटशी सुसंगत. PMKISAN साठी टूलमध्ये 'No scheme data found' असूनही लाभ लिहिले; BAKSY ची SC-फक्त पात्रता स्पष्टपणे नमूद नाही.

no_fabrication.evidence: PMKISAN बद्दल ₹6,000/वर्ष इ. माहिती दिली तरी टूलने कोणतीही माहिती परत केली नाही; रिकाम्या टूल-आउटपुटवर माहिती तयार करणे टाळायला हवे होते.

citation_accuracy.evidence: 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' ही अपेक्षित मांडणी बरोबर वापरली; अंतर्गत टूल नावे नाहीत.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - reason: कीडनियंत्रण/डोसेज/कायदेशीरता संबंधित सल्ला नाही.

completeness.evidence: वापरकर्त्याने 'माझ्या पिकासाठी' विचारले; पीक विचरले नाही व पीक-केंद्रित प्रमुख योजना (PMFBY, RWBCIS, MIDH area expansion, PM-RKVY Per Drop More Crop, NFSNM) गाळल्या. फक्त 3 योजना दिल्या, त्यातील एक SC-विशिष्ट.

actionability.evidence: MahaDBT वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज असे साधारण मार्गदर्शन दिले पण कोणतीही URL/स्टेप-बाय-स्टेप प्रक्रिया/कागदपत्रांची पूर्ण यादी नाही; PMKISAN साठीही पोर्टल लिंक नाही.

context_fit.evidence: Agristack ✅ असूनही वैयक्तिकरण नाही (PoCRA/जाती/जमीन); BAKSY सुचवली पण SC-फक्त पात्रता स्पष्ट नाही; 'पीक' संदर्भात माहिती मागितली तरी पीक विचारले नाही.

clarity.evidence: उतरे विभागानुसार स्वच्छ, वाचनीय; प्रत्येक योजनेसाठी छोटा परिच्छेद.

conversation_closure.evidence: फॉलो-अप विचारले पण पीक/हंगाम/सिंचन स्थिती यावर नेमके प्रश्न नाहीत.

grammar.evidence: बहुतेक वाक्यरचना बरोबर.

terminology.evidence: 'तीन बरोबर भागांमध्ये' ऐवजी 'तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये' हवे; 'शेती यंत्रसामग्री' शब्दप्रयोग हवा.

language_purity.evidence: अनावश्यक इंग्रजी नाही; योजना नावे इंग्रजीत स्वीकार्य.

fluency.evidence: काही वाक्ये थोडी कृत्रिम/अनैसर्गिक; प्रवाहीपणात सुधारणा शक्य.

evaluation.summary: उत्तरेत काही योजना दिल्या आणि स्रोत योग्य दिला, पण 'पीकासाठी' या गरजेनुसार प्रमुख पीक-आधारित योजना गाळल्या आणि Agristack असूनही वैयक्तिकरण झाले नाही. PMKISAN साठी टूलमध्ये डेटा न मिळाल्यानेही तपशील लिहिणे ही गंभीर चूक (fabrication) आहे.

question: माझ्या शेतासाठी ट्रॅक्टर किंवा हातमुद्रक यंत्रासाठी कोणत्या शासकीय योजनेचा लाभ मिळेल?
answer:
**Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PMKISAN)**
- **प्रमुख विशेषता:** प्रत्येक कुटुंबाला प्रत्येक वर्षी ₹6,000 अनुदान, तीन बरोबरीचे हप्ते ₹2,000 प्रत्येक.
- **लाभार्ह अर्हता:** जमिनीचा मालक असलेले शेतकरी कुटुंब.
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:** 7/12 नोंदणी, जमीन लागवड, आधार लिंक, ई-केवायसी.
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** https://pmkisan.gov.in या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन.

**स्थानिक शासकीय योजना - कृषी यंत्रसामग्री व वाहनांसाठी:**
- **स्टेट स्पॉन्सर्ड अॅग्रीकल्चर मॅक्सिनेशन (SDDA):**
  - **लाभार्ह यंत्र/वाहन:** ट्रॅक्टर, पावर टिलर, ट्रॅक्टर-चालित यंत्र, पीकरक्षक यंत्र, प्राथमिक प्रक्रिया यंत्र.
  - **सब्सिडी:** एससी, एसटी, लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी ४०%, इतरांसाठी ५०% खर्चाचे अनुदान.
  - **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन.
  - **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:** यंत्राचा टेस्ट रिपोर्ट, ट्रॅक्टरचा आरसी, बाजारात खरेदीची बिले.

**केंद्रीय योजना - फार्म मशीनरी बँक (CHC):**
- **लाभार्ह यंत्र/वाहन:** ट्रॅक्टर, पावर टिलर, ड्रोन.
- **सब्सिडी:** फार्म मशीनरी बँकसाठी ४०%, ड्रोनसाठी शिक्षितांसाठी ५०% आणि इतरांसाठी ४०% खर्चाचे अनुदान.
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन.
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:** यंत्राचा टेस्ट रिपोर्ट, ट्रॅक्टरचा आरसी, शासकीय रजिस्ट्रेशन प्रमाणपत्र.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्या शेतासाठी ट्रॅक्टर किंवा हातमुद्रक यंत्रासाठी या योजनांचा लाभ मिळू शकतो. आपण यापैकी कोणत्या योजनेचा अर्ज करायचा आहे का, किंवा अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

question: पिकांच्या लागवडीसाठी शेतकरी मशीनरीसाठी कोणत्या अनुदान योजना उपलब्ध आहेत?
answer:
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
शेतकरी मशीनरीसाठी अनुदान योजना म्हणजे **"स्टेट स्पॉन्सर्ड एग्रीकल्चर मॅक्सनायझेशन" (State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization)** आणि **"डॉ. बाबासाहेब अम्बेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)"** या दोन योजना आहेत.

**1. स्टेट स्पॉन्सर्ड एग्रीकल्चर मॅक्सनायझेशन (State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization):**
- ही योजना शेतकऱ्यांना शेतीसाठी आवश्यक फार्म मशीनरी आणि कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर (CHC) यासाठी अनुदान देते.
- या योजनेत ४०% फंड फार्म मशीनरी बँक आणि कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर (CHC) स्थापनेसाठी दिला जातो.
- शेतकऱ्यांना इच्छित फार्म मशीनरी खरेदीसाठी खाजगी बाजारातून खरेदी करता येते, त्यानंतर अनुदान डीबीटी (Direct Benefit Transfer) पद्धतीने त्यांच्या आधार लिंक बँक खात्यात जारी केले जाते.

**2. डॉ. बाबासाहेब अम्बेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY):**
- ही योजना मुख्यतः शेतकऱ्यांना शेतीसाठी विविध इंजिनिअरिंग आणि इंजिनरिंग आधारित विविध यंत्रसामग्रीसाठी अनुदान देते.
- या योजनेत नवीन इंजिनिअरिंग बोरिंग, जुना बोरिंग दुरुस्ती, प्लास्टिक लाइनिंग, विद्युत संपर्क, पंप सेट, सोलर पंप, एचडीपीई/पीव्हीसी पाईप, स्प्रिंकलर आणि ड्रिप इरिगेशन सेट, फार्म मशीनरी आणि बॅकगार्ड/किचन गार्डन यासाठी अनुदान दिले जाते.
- या योजनेत शेतकऱ्यांना आपल्या शेतात वापरायच्या यंत्रसामग्रीसाठी अनुदान दिले जाते, ज्यामध्ये अनुदानाची मर्यादा वेगवेगळ्या घटकांसाठी निश्चित केलेली आहे.
- या योजनेचा लाभ फक्त शेतकऱ्यांना मिळतो ज्यांचा जातीप्रमाणपत्र आहे आणि त्यांच्याकडे ०.२० हेक्टर ते ६.०० हेक्टर शेतजमीन आहे.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
आपल्याला या योजनांपैकी कोणत्या एकाची अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का, किंवा इतर शेतकरी मशीनरीसाठी अनुदान योजना आहेत का?

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

question: शेतासाठी हार्वेस्टर घेण्यास कोणती योजना मदत करते?
answer:
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

शेतासाठी हार्वेस्टर (कापणी यंत्र) घेण्यास खालील योजना मदत करते:

1. **स्थानिक शासनाची शेती यंत्रसामग्री प्रदान योजना (State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization)**
   - ही योजना शेतकऱ्यांना फायद्याची आहे.
   - यामध्ये ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, स्वयंचलित यंत्रसामग्री, ट्रॅक्टर-चालित अंमलबजावणी, फसल रक्षण अंमलबजावणी, आणि पिक काढण्यानंतरच्या प्राथमिक प्रक्रिया यंत्रसामग्रीसाठी मदत मिळते.
   - शेतकऱ्यांना यंत्रसामग्री खरेदीसाठी फायद्याची रक्कम मिळते. शेतकऱ्यांना ४०% फायदा दिला जातो, तर शेतकऱ्यांच्या वर्गानुसार अधिक फायदा दिला जातो.
   - शेतकऱ्यांनी यंत्रसामग्रीची खरेदी खुल्या बाजारात केली जाते, आणि फायदा डीबीटी पद्धतीने शेतकऱ्याच्या आधार लिंक बँक खात्यात जमा केली जाते.
   - अर्ज करण्यासाठी, शेतकरी वेबसाईट https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in वर जाऊन अर्ज करू शकतात.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

*Id*:
61

*Scheme Code*:
sdda-farm-machinery-and-equipments

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
DDA MECHANIZATION

*Scheme Name*:
State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Farm Machinery and Equipments.

*Sub Component*:
Tractors, power tillers, automated machinery, tractor-operated implements, tractor-operated crop protection implements, and post-harvest primary processing implements.

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. Financial assistance to farmers for procurement of farm machinery and implements
2. Generally, the subsidy is given at a rate of 40 % for SC, ST & small farmers, Womens & 50% for other farmers percent of the cost or the maximum subsidy limit declared by the Central Government, whichever is lower.

*Eligibility*:
Individual Farmer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

question: मी नवीन शेतकरी आहे, कोणत्या योजना माझ्यासाठी सर्वप्रथम उपलब्ध आहेत?
answer:
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

नवीन शेतकऱ्यांसाठी महाराष्ट्रातील काही महत्त्वाच्या शासकीय योजना हे आहेत:

**१. भाऊसाहेब फंडकर हॉर्टिकल्चर प्लांटेशन योजना (Bhausaheb Fundkar Horticulture Plantation Scheme)**
- या योजनेमध्ये फळांच्या लागवडीसाठी १००% सवलत मिळते.
- लागवडीची रक्कम तीन वर्षांत तीन वेळा आधार-लिंक बँक खात्यात प्रत्यक्ष जमा केली जाते.
- योजनेचा लाभ आपल्या शेतात विविध फळांसाठी (महुआ, गुवा, काशी, सपोटा, पंचमूल, कुस्ती, कांगडी लिंब, नारळ, अंजीर, अमला, कोकम, जामुन, नारंगी, मीठाचे लिंब) मिळू शकतो.
- योजनेचा लाभ लाभार्थी निवडीसाठी महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर लॉटरी प्रक्रियेद्वारे केली जाते.

**२. गोपीनाथ मुंडे शेतकरी आपघात सुरक्षा सन्मान योजना (Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Suraksha Sanugrah Anudan Yojna)**
- या योजनेमध्ये शेतकऱ्यांना आपघाताच्या सुरक्षेसाठी आर्थिक साहाय्य मिळते.
- या योजनेसाठी शेतकऱ्याची नोंदणी करावी लागते.

**३. प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**
- या योजनेमध्ये शेतकऱ्यांना वर्षात ६,००० रुपये मिळतात.
- या योजनेसाठी शेतकऱ्याची नोंदणी करावी लागते.

**४. चिफ मिनिस्टर सस्टेनेबल अॅग्रीकल्चर इरिगेशन व्यक्तिगत फार्म पॉंड योजना (Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Individual Farm Pond)**
- या योजनेमध्ये शेतकऱ्यांना व्यक्तिगत फार्म पॉंड बांधण्यासाठी आर्थिक साहाय्य मिळते.
- या योजनेसाठी शेतकऱ्याची नोंदणी करावी लागते.

आपल्याला या योजनांपैकी कोणत्या योजनेची माहिती अधिक जास्तीत जास्त वाचायची आहे का? किंवा आपल्या शेतातील लागवडीसाठी कोणत्या योजनेचा लाभ घेता येतो, ते जाणून घ्यायचे आहे का?

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

question: मी सोयाबीन आणि कापूस दोन्ही पिकतो, कोणत्या योजनेत अर्ज करणे फायदेशीर आहे?
answer:
**Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi (NSMNY)**
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

**नाम: नमो शेतकरी महासंमान निधी (NSMNY)**
**मुख्य घटक: नमो शेतकरी महासंमान निधी (NSMNY)**
**स्वीकृत फायदा: ₹6,000 प्रति कुटुंब प्रति वर्ष, तीन समान भागात (प्रत्येक ₹2,000)**
**पात्रता: पीएमकिसान योजनेत पात्र असलेल्या शेतकऱ्यांसाठी**
**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: ७/१२ नोंदणी, जमीन तयार, आधार नोंदणी व ई-केवायसी**
**अर्ज प्रक्रिया: पीएमकिसान योजनेत अर्ज केलेल्या शेतकऱ्यांना अतिरिक्त नमो शेतकरी महासंमान निधीचा फायदा मिळतो, अर्ज आवश्यक नाही**

**Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)**
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

**नाम: डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**
**मुख्य घटक: अनुसूचित जाती (SC) शेतकऱ्यांना इंजिनियरिंग सुविधा**
**स्वीकृत फायदा: नवीन जलसंपदा, जुना कुऱ्या दुरुस्ती, फार्म पॉन्ड लाइनिंग, इनवेल बोरिंग, विद्युत संपर्क, पंप सेट, सौर पंप, HDPE/PVC पाईप, स्प्रिंकलर व ड्रिप इरिगेशन सेट, शेत यंत्रसामग्री, बॅकयार्ड गार्डन**
**पात्रता: अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकरी, जमीन अवधि ०.२० हेक्टर ते ६.०० हेक्टर, आधार लिंक बँक खाते**
**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: अनुसूचित जाती नोंदणी, जमीन नोंदणी, आधार नोंदणी**

**पात्रता: शिफारसीत निकृष्ट शेतकरी कुटुंब, जमीन तयार**

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

term_identification.evidence: N/A - This is a schemes query, not an advisory diagnosis; no search_terms/search_documents used or needed.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Followed get_scheme_codes → multiple get_scheme_info calls. This works but is suboptimal versus get_multiple_schemes_info for comparing several relevant schemes.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search performed; only scheme tools used.

question: सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी कोणती योजना उपलब्ध आहे?
answer:
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी महाराष्ट्रात "नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प" (NDKSP) अंतर्गत अनेक योजना उपलब्ध आहेत. यामध्ये एक महत्त्वाची योजना म्हणजे "वर्मीकॉम्पोस आणि नॅडेप कॉम्पोस उत्पादन युनिट" आहे. ही योजना शेतकऱ्यांना त्यांच्या शेतातील जमीनीवर उत्पन्न झालेल्या जैविक साधनांचा वापर करून उत्तम कॉम्पोस तयार करण्याची सुविधा देते.

ही योजना विशेषतः अशा शेतकऱ्यांसाठी लाभदायी आहे ज्यांच्याकडे दोन मोठे पशू (गाई, भेंड, गुरू) आहेत, ज्यांच्याकडे ५ हेक्टरपर्यंत जमीन आहे, आणि जे पोसिस वाडा (PoCRA) वाड्यांमध्ये राहतात.

ही योजना शेतकऱ्यांना खतांचा खर्च कमी करून, जमिनीची उत्तम निर्मिती ठेवून, आणि शेती उत्पन्नात वाढ करून लाभ देते.

**नोंदणीची प्रक्रिया:**
- शेतकरी त्यांच्या फार्मर ID वापरून "महाविस्तार-एआय" अॅप किंवा "NDKSP 2.0" वेबसाइटवर लॉगिन करू शकतात.
- "DBT" टॅबवर क्लिक करून आणि "NDKSP (PoCRA)" टॅबवर जाऊन, या योजनेसाठी नवीन अर्ज भरू शकतात.
- अर्ज केल्यानंतर तपशीलवार माहिती आणि आवश्यक कागदपत्रे (जैसे जात प्रमाणपत्र, अक्षरशास्त्रीय प्रमाणपत्र इ.) सबमिट करावी लागतात.

ही योजना फक्त पोसिस वाड्यांमधील शेतकऱ्यांसाठी उपलब्ध आहे. तुम्हाला इतर कोणत्या योजना किंवा अर्जाबद्दल माहिती हवी आहे का?

**स्रोत: नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (NDKSP) मार्गदर्शक सूचना**

*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-organic-production-unit

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Organic Production Unit

*Sub Component*:
1. Vermicompost Production Unit 
2. NADEP Compost Production Unit

*Introduction*:
Under the organic farming system, conserving nature, reducing crop production costs, and increasing the use of alternative organic and biological inputs for hazardous chemicals like chemical fertilizers, pesticides, herbicides, and hormones is the need of the hour. Vermicompost is made from farm waste, plant-based materials, and cow dung by earthworms. Vermicompost contains various bacteria, enzymes, vitamins, and other useful chemicals, which have a positive effect on plant growth. 
Similarly, processing farm waste through composting results in the decomposition of its organic matter through biological methods by microorganisms and earthworms, producing excellent humus-like organic compost. If this compost is used extensively in the fields, it will significantly improve soil health and greatly boost agricultural production. It is the need of the hour to prepare organic manure from all plant-based materials generated in the field and return it to the field. Organic manure improves soil texture and water retention capacity, ensuring an adequate supply of nutrients. The soil remains friable, which keeps it aerated. It helps in the growth of beneficial microorganisms in the farm. 
In this regard, considering the above matter, it is proposed to implement the Vermicompost Production Unit and NADEP Compost Production Unit as individual benefit components.

*Benefits*:
1.To enable small and marginal farmers in the village clusters included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to adapt to the situation arising from climate change.
2. To produce nutritious food grains.
3. To practice agriculture by making proper use of natural elements without harming them.
4. To increase soil fertility and maintain it for a long time.
5. To reuse local resources in agriculture.
6. To reduce the cost of agricultural production and increase the net income of the farmer.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits again under this scheme.
2. After the unit is established, the benefit will be given to farmers who have at least two large livestock (cows, buffaloes, or bullocks) available to ensure its proper functioning.
3. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5.00 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes category, evidence related to that.
3. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

*Source Url*:
https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Vermicompost_and_NADEP_Compost_Production_Unit_Guidelines.pdf

This scheme is eligible for PoCRA villages only.

question: लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी कोणत्या योजनांमध्ये अनुदान जास्त मिळते?
answer:
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी अनुदानाची जास्तीत जास्त मिळणारी योजना म्हणजे **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PMKISAN)** आहे. या योजनेमध्ये, शेतकऱ्यांच्या कुटुंबाला वर्षाला ₹6,000 अनुदान दिले जाते, जे तीन वेळा ₹2,000 प्रत्येकी म्हणजे वर्षाला एकूण ₹6,000 म्हणून दिले जाते. या योजनेचा लाभ शेतकऱ्यांच्या जमिनीच्या भागावर अवलंबून असतो, ज्यांच्याकडे शेतीसाठी जमीन असते.  

दुसऱ्या महत्त्वाच्या योजना म्हणजे **डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**, जी मुख्यतः शेतकऱ्यांना पिकांसाठी पाणी व्यवस्थापनाची सोय, विविध शेती साधनांची उपलब्धता, व खाद्य सुरक्षा वाढीसाठी अनुदान देते. या योजनेमध्ये, नवीन पाण्याचे खड्डे, जुन्या खड्ड्यांची दुरुस्ती, खेतातील पाण्याचे टाकणारे ट्रॅक्टर, व विविध खेत साधनांचे अनुदान दिले जाते. या योजनेतील अनुदान नेमक्या शेतकऱ्याच्या आवश्यकतेवर आणि त्याच्या जमिनीच्या आकारावर अवलंबून असते.  

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
आपल्याला यापैकी कोणत्या योजनेची अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का? किंवा इतर कोणत्या योजनेबद्दल विचारायचे आहे?

*Id*:
65

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

term_identification.evidence: User asked which schemes give higher subsidy for small farmers. The agent highlighted PM-KISAN (income support, not a subsidy) and BAKSY only; it missed key high-subsidy options like PMKRVY Per Drop More Crop, SDDA/CDDA machinery, CMSAISFP top-ups, and PoCRA ndksp-* where applicable.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Followed get_scheme_codes → get_scheme_info for PMKISAN and BAKSY, though with some 'No scheme data found' retries. Did not use get_multiple_schemes_info despite multiple relevant schemes possible.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search used for this scheme-info request.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or raw payloads leaked; response text is clean.

source_alignment.evidence: PM-KISAN details (₹6,000/year in three ₹2,000 instalments) match tool output; BAKSY described broadly without contradicting tool data. However, the claim that PM-KISAN is the 'maximum subsidy' for small farmers is not supported by tool outputs.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented scheme names, amounts, deadlines, or guarantees. The agent avoided specific percentages for BAKSY not shown in its response.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Uses 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती', the expected farmer-friendly citation for scheme info.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No chemical advisories or safety-sensitive recommendations involved.

completeness.evidence: Missed major relevant schemes that typically offer higher subsidies to small/marginal farmers (e.g., PMKRVY Per Drop More Crop for micro-irrigation, SDDA/CDDA machinery subsidies, CMSAISFP top-ups, and PoCRA ndksp-* where applicable). Did not provide eligibility nuances, required documents, or application steps.

actionability.evidence: No portal URL, documents list, or step-by-step guidance; only a generic offer for more information.

context_fit.evidence: With Agristack ✅ available, the agent did not tailor by small farmer status, caste (SC/ST), PoCRA village, or landholding; also emphasized PM-KISAN (income support) rather than higher subsidy schemes.

clarity.evidence: Content is understandable and organized in short paragraphs without clutter.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a generic follow-up question but does not propose specific next steps or related schemes proactively.

grammar.evidence: Sentences are largely grammatical and coherent.

terminology.evidence: Used non-standard terms like 'खेत' and 'खड्डे' instead of 'शेती'/'विहीर/तलाव'; lacked precise terms like 'सूक्ष्म सिंचन', 'यंत्रीकरण' relevant to the topic.

language_purity.evidence: Minimal English usage; scheme names retained as proper nouns.

fluency.evidence: Flow is slightly stilted and includes awkward phrasing (e.g., 'खेतातील पाण्याचे टाकणारे ट्रॅक्टर'); duplicated 'स्रोत' line disrupts smoothness.

An unsupported comparative claim about PM-KISAN being the 'maximum subsidy' further weakens relevance.

question: केळी बागेसाठी कोणत्या सरकारी योजनेचा लाभ मिळू शकतो?
answer:
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

केळी बागेसाठी खालील सरकारी योजना उपलब्ध आहेत:

1. **भाऊसाहेब फंडकर हॉर्टिकल्चर प्लांटेशन योजना (Bhausaheb Fundkar Horticulture Plantation Scheme)** – या योजनेअंतर्गत केळी, लिंबू, खजूर, आंबा, गुडहळी, नाशपाती, केसरी इत्यादी फळ बागायतीसाठी लाभ मिळतो.

2. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प हॉर्टिकल्चर प्लांटेशन (NDKSP Horticulture Plantation)** – या योजनेअंतर्गत केळी, लिंबू, खजूर, आंबा, गुडहळी, नाशपाती, केसरी इत्यादी फळ बागायतीसाठी लाभ मिळतो.

3. **नामो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)** – या योजनेअंतर्गत शेतकऱ्यांना वर्षातील ६ हजार रुपये तीन भागांमध्ये दिले जातात.

4. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PMKISAN)** – या योजनेअंतर्गत शेतकऱ्यांना वर्षातील ६ हजार रुपये तीन भागांमध्ये दिले जातात.

**महत्वाचे नियम:**
- या योजना केवळ पोसीकरा (PoCRA) गावांसाठी उपलब्ध आहेत.
- शेतकऱ्यांनी आपल्या नावावरील भूमीपत्र, आधार, ई-केवायसी व इतर आवश्यक कागदपत्रे जमा करावीत.
- योजनेचे अर्ज महाविस्तार-एआय अॅप अथवा PMKISAN पोर्टल (pmkisan.gov.in) वर ऑनलाइन दाखल करता येतात.

आपण कोणत्या योजनेची माहिती अधिक जास्त जाणून घेण्याची इच्छा करता आहात का?

*Introduction*:
The increased level of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere is an important factor associated with climate change. The plantation of fruit orchards (perennial trees) is very effective in the process of sequestering this carbon dioxide (Carbon Sequestration). Along with the economic upliftment of farmers, sequestering the carbon dioxide that causes climate change is an objective of this project.

*Benefits*:
1. To expand climate-resilient farming practices through the plantation of long-term income-generating fruit crops. 
2. To achieve the objective of increasing farmers' income by generating regular and maximum income from horticulture plantation. 
3. To establish orchards of long-term, income-generating fruit crops that survive on less water, providing a supplementary business to rainfed agriculture. 
4. To reduce soil erosion and promote the conservation of green cover. 
5. To increase Carbon Sequestration.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the land falls under the Tenancy Act and the tenant's name is on the 7/12 extract, a consent letter from the tenant will be required to implement the scheme.
3. The selected beneficiary for this component should not have availed government subsidy earlier for plantation activities (such as fruit orchards, tree plantation, bamboo, etc.) on the said area.
4. The beneficiary should have the necessary irrigation facilities required for the cultivation of the proposed fruit crop.
5. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries holding up to 5.00 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
2. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes category, certificate related to that.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agristack ✅ was available but not fetched; response gave general info without personalization or PoCRA eligibility check from profile. For a general scheme info query this is acceptable, but the reply also applied a blanket PoCRA rule incorrectly.

term_identification.evidence: User asked for banana orchard schemes. Assistant listed BFHPS, NDKSP horticulture, NSMNY, and PM-KISAN. It missed key horticulture schemes relevant to banana like MIDH Area Expansion (mah adbt-midh-area-expansion-fruit-flower) and PMKSY Per Drop More Crop for drip; included general income-support schemes not specific to banana.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Flow used get_scheme_codes → multiple get_scheme_info calls, which is acceptable. However, included schemes (BFHPS, NSMNY) had 'No scheme data found' yet were still presented with details; should not surface schemes without successful info retrieval or should fetch alternatives (get_multiple_schemes_info).

search_quality.evidence: N/A - Scheme info workflow did not involve document search

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or raw JSON leaked; clean, end-user-friendly text only.

source_alignment.evidence: NDKSP horticulture tool output subcomponents do not list banana, yet assistant claimed it covers banana. BFHPS and NSMNY returned 'No scheme data found' but assistant asserted benefits. Also stated 'या योजना केवळ PoCRA गावांसाठी उपलब्ध' applying to all listed schemes, which contradicts PM-KISAN (not PoCRA-restricted).

no_fabrication.evidence: Fabricated inclusion of banana under NDKSP horticulture without tool backing; invented BFHPS crop coverage and NSMNY benefit details despite 'No scheme data found'.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used the standard 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' citation, which matches expectations for scheme info.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No agronomic chemical advice or safety-sensitive recommendations given.

completeness.evidence: Missed key banana-relevant schemes (e.g., MIDH Area Expansion for fruit/banana, PMKSY Per Drop More Crop for drip, post-harvest support). Did not provide per-scheme benefits, eligibility, documents, and application steps for relevant schemes.

actionability.evidence: Provided generic note about documents and portals (PMKISAN URL), but lacked specific application links and document lists for banana schemes (e.g., MIDH, PoCRA page), and misapplied PoCRA restriction.

context_fit.evidence: Agristack was available but unused; no personalization (PoCRA status, land size, caste). Moreover, incorrectly applied PoCRA-only condition to all schemes including PM-KISAN, reducing contextual correctness.

clarity.evidence: Bulleted list with simple Marathi phrasing; easy to read despite inaccuracies.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a generic follow-up question asking which scheme to know more about; could be more specific (e.g., ask if farmer is in PoCRA village, area under banana, irrigation status).

grammar.evidence: Sentences are grammatically correct overall.

terminology.evidence: Uses योजना, लाभ, अर्ज correctly; however, 'पोसीकरा (PoCRA)' is an awkward transliteration and crop list terms appear imprecise.

language_purity.evidence: Mostly Marathi; limited necessary English (scheme names/portals) only.

fluency.evidence: Understandable but slightly stilted and repetitive; some awkward phrasing around PoCRA note.

evaluation.summary: Response is clearly written but contains fabricated and misaligned scheme details, incorrectly applies PoCRA restriction to all schemes, and misses key banana-relevant schemes like MIDH area expansion and PMKSY drip. It also fails to use Agristack for personalization and provides limited actionable next steps.

question: पिक विमा योजनांचा अर्ज कसा करावा आणि कोणत्या पिकांसाठी आहे?
answer:
**Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)**
- या योजनेमध्ये, जाहीर केलेल्या शेतकऱ्यांना आणि जाहीर केलेल्या क्षेत्रात लावलेल्या फसांसाठी बीमा कवच दिले जाते.
- योजनेचा लाभ शेतकऱ्यांना आपल्या फसात नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, जीवाणू आणि रोगांमुळे फसा नुकसान झाल्यास मिळतो.
- बीमा दर प्रति हेक्टर शेतावर आणि फसाच्या प्रकारानुसार ठरविले जाते.
- या योजनेची अर्ज करण्यासाठी शेतकरी ऑनलाइन पोर्टल [www.pmfby.gov.in](https://www.pmfby.gov.in) वर जाता येतो.
- अर्ज करताना शेतकऱ्याचे आधार कार्ड, बँक खात्याची माहिती, शेताची माहिती आणि डिजिटल पिक पहाणी अहवाल द्यावा लागतो.
- या योजनेचा लाभ शेतकऱ्यांना बँक खात्यात जमा करून दिला जातो.
- शेतकऱ्यांनी या योजनेसाठी अर्ज करण्याची तारीख नक्की तपासून घ्यावी.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-pmfby

*Sponsor*:
Central

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Main Component*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

*Source Url*:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZB_bKSL1ifewQkA4-ksxeQfqWFfcoc_l/view

question: माझ्या शेतात नवीन ड्रिप प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अर्ज कसा करावा?
answer:
**ठिबक सिंचन प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अर्ज कसा करावा?**

1. शेतात ठिबक सिंचन प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी पहिल्याने शेतकरी योजनेचे नाव व अर्ज प्रक्रिया जाणून घ्यावी. उदा. "Per Drop More Crop" योजना, "NDKSP उद्यानविद्या लागवड" योजना, किंवा इतर संबंधित योजना.
2. शेतकरी अर्ज करताना ठिबक सिंचन प्रणालीची लागवड, झाडांचे अंतर, शेताचे क्षेत्रफळ, वापरायच्या खतांची माहिती द्यावी.
3. अर्ज करताना निर्दिष्ट अनुदान, वापरायच्या संच व विविध शेती तंत्रांची माहिती द्यावी.
4. शेतकरी योजनेतील प्रक्रियेनुसार अर्ज करावा. अर्जासाठी शेतकरी कृषी विज्ञान केंद्र (KVK), विभागीय कृषी कार्यालय, किंवा इतर संबंधित सेवा केंद्रांवर जावे.
5. अर्जासोबत शेताचा भूखंड नकाशा, शेतातील झाडांचे अंतर, वापरायच्या ठिबक सिंचन प्रणालीचे वर्णन, शेतकऱ्याचे नाव, शेताचे क्षेत्रफळ, व इतर आवश्यक कागदपत्रे द्यावीत.
6. अर्ज करण्यासाठी शेतकरी शासकीय योजना माहिती, कृषी विज्ञान केंद्र किंवा विभागीय कृषी कार्यालयात जावे.
7. अर्ज व शेतकऱ्याची शिफारस केल्यावर शेतात ठिबक सिंचन प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अनुदान व तंत्रज्ञानाची मदत मिळेल.

**स्रोत: शेतकरी शासकीय योजना माहिती**

question: माझ्या जमिनीच्या आकारानुसार PM-KISAN मध्ये किती रक्कम मिळेल?
answer:
**PM-KISAN योजनेतील फायदा:**
**प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)** ही योजना आर्थिकदृष्ट्या कमकुवत शेतकऱ्यांना वार्षिक रुपाने ₹6,000/- देण्याची आहे, ज्यातील ₹2,000/- प्रत्येक तिन्ही वेळा देण्यात येतात. या योजनेसाठी शेतकऱ्याची पात्रता असते, जर त्याच्याकडे शेती करण्याची जमीन असेल.

आपल्या प्रोफाइलनुसार, आपल्या जमिनीचे क्षेत्रफळ ०.६८ हेक्टर आहे. या योजनेत जमीन असलेल्या शेतकऱ्यांना वार्षिक रुपाने ₹6,000/- मिळतात. यासाठी शेतकऱ्याचे ७/१२ नोंदणीपत्र, आधार कार्ड, आणि ई-केवायसी आवश्यक आहेत.

आपण ऑनलाइन पोर्टल प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (pmkisan.gov.in) वर अर्ज करू शकता.
